task.title: P6-098: Cap catalog card grid size at wide viewports
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Visual and layout). Original id: P6-098. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**Catalog card size is uncapped at wide viewports** — `GRID_CLASS` (`catalog.rs:670`) tops out at `xl:grid-cols-6` with no `max-w` or container wrapper anywhere in the file, so cards keep growing with the window.
